name: livespec host: RAM-available floor breach (avg free < 8 GiB)
description: P-host resource-health safety net (plan/fabro-ci-image-factoring, livespec-3lev.1). Fires when host average free RAM (system.memory.usage state=free) stays below the ~8 GiB hardware-derived hard floor for 2 consecutive 15-min windows (sustained saturation, not a transient dip). Swap is 0 on this host, so there is no cushion below this floor — a sustained breach is the PAUSE-for-provision signal for the maintainer to bump host resources. Threshold is hardware-derived, NOT a multi-day percentile baseline (that approach was retired 2026-07-12). Under normal load free RAM sits ~56-69 GiB, ~7x above this floor, so it cannot spuriously fire. Follow-on .1(a) signals still to wire: sustained CPU-idle-near-0 duration (soft hint) and a disk-free floor (hygiene).
